children: New York, New York--(Newsfile Corp. - September 22, 2026) - Sparta Commercial Services, Inc. (OTCQB: SRCO) ("Sparta" or the "Company"), a nationwide provider of municipal financing solutions, today announced the completion of two additional financing transactions with the Town of Candor, North Carolina through Sparta's Municipal Finance Program.

The latest financings represent the twelfth and thirteenth municipal transactions completed between Sparta and the Town of Candor since 2014. Over the course of the relationship, the Town has utilized Sparta's financing platform to acquire a broad range of essential municipal assets, including police vehicles, fire equipment, industrial vacuum systems, and maintenance equipment.

"Sparta has been a dependable financing resource for the Town of Candor for many years," said Tammy Kellis, Town Clerk and Finance Officer for the Town of Candor. "Their familiarity with municipal budgeting and procurement timelines has made the process straightforward and responsive to our needs. Having access to flexible financing options allows us to continue upgrading important equipment while managing expenditures responsibly."

Sparta's Municipal Finance Program is designed to help municipalities, emergency service providers, and public agencies obtain critical-use equipment through structured financing programs tailored to government budgeting requirements. The program supports financing across numerous asset categories, including emergency response vehicles, fire and rescue apparatus, public works equipment, transportation assets, and other capital equipment utilized in day-to-day municipal operations.

"We greatly appreciate the continued confidence the Town of Candor has placed in Sparta over the years," said Anthony Havens, Chief Executive Officer of Sparta Commercial Services. "Long-standing municipal relationships are especially meaningful to us because they demonstrate our ability to consistently deliver financing solutions that align with the operational priorities and financial objectives of local governments. We remain committed to helping municipalities secure the equipment they need in a cost-effective and efficient manner."
